description: Strikemaster Mk 82, gate guard at RAFO Masirah (dstorm.eu 'gate guard, RAFO Masirah', with earlier photos at Salalah 1973 and 1989; bacstrikemaster.co.uk survivors list c.2010 'preserved, RAFO Masirah'). No dated recent photo found. A second Masirah airframe, Mk 82A 422, was listed 'in storage' at Masirah in 2010 and is noted here only. Coordinates are the airfield reference point.
